generate_mock_classes: run gmock_class.py on a C++ header file to generate Google Mock classes for all classes
generate_mock_for_class: run gmock_class.py on a header file with a specific class name to generate its mock
render_type: use _RenderType to convert an AST type node into a readable C++ type string with templates
generate_methods: use _GenerateMethods to emit MOCK_METHOD macros for all virtual functions in a class AST node
get_num_parameters: use _GetNumParameters to count function parameters treating T(void) as zero parameters
